cohort_C0_choice_rationale: FROZEN SPEC prefers 'the candidate store's full analyzed roster at its newest stamp_date'. The store's engine (curated) writer stalled after 2026-08-07 (last night engine.build_stock_library produced a curated-tier population); the scan writer (liquidity-floored, disjoint by construction from curated) continued through 2026-08-12. 2026-08-07 is therefore the newest stamp_date carrying BOTH writer outputs, i.e. the fullest analyzed roster the store has ever recorded in one night (curated 1717 + scan 1510, disjoint by dedupe-key construction per data/us_prophet_rank/README.md 'Two coverage tiers, one store'). This union (3227) is also empirically the largest closed US-name roster found among all alternatives inspected below.
cohort_C1_stale_note: newest row in the store as of pin computation; the store is STALLED (curated writer has not produced a row since 2026-08-07). This stamp is 5 calendar days behind the D1 build session (2026-08-17). Only tier='scan' rows exist at this stamp — 'curated' (the board's actual graded population) has not refreshed since C0's stamp.
cohort_C2_note: closed_count is DISTINCT tickers among the 206 plan rows actually present in the array (=active_count); plan_count=228 in the header includes 22 non-active plans not carried in the array (retired/archived before this asof) and are therefore NOT enumerable as tickers from this artifact — recorded, not fabricated.
cohort_C3_note: coverage.triggered=831 in the artifact's own summary equals deck(40)+beyond_cap(791) exactly, confirming the two lists are disjoint by construction.
cohort_C4_null_reason: No materialized probe-set artifact exists under data/ or site/ at pin 5c1d82b928 — searched data/*entry_radar*, data/breadth/, site/*radar* and found no persisted output of engine/entry_radar/universe.py::assemble_probe_set(). The Probe Set (Layers A-D funnel: A=broad eligibility lens, B=index membership/liquid names/watchlist, C=dynamic-hot attention admission, D=lobe nominations auto-admit) is DEFINED in code (engine/entry_radar/universe.py, 1027 lines) with a soft target envelope of 500-1,500 names, but is computed at runtime from data/breadth/constituents.parquet + midcap/smallcap/russell siblings and is never written to a stamped store this repo snapshot can read. Per the build packet's explicit instruction, this is recorded as UNKNOWN-with-reason rather than fabricated by running the funnel (out of scope: no engine edits, no new computation of scored/gated artifacts).
cohort_C5_field_rationale: The candidates store carries its own 'featured' column, but it is null on every row at C1's stamp (2026-08-12) — checked directly: all-null=True. site/factordata/us_standouts.json's 'buy' list (board_definition us_prophet_v3) is the only materialized 'currently featured/top' population at this pin: eligible=true, signal.tier='take' names selected for the board's buy lane. 'watch' (48 names) is a separate, lower-conviction lane and is NOT counted as featured.
union_order_note: Incremental coverage is computed walking this fixed order; each source's 'incremental_new_names' counts names NOT already covered by an earlier source in the order. 'structural_sector_industry' is last by design -- it is deliberately the floor/fallback, not a thematic source (coordinator addendum: GICS sector/industry and the 11 us_sector_* pseudo-baskets are STRUCTURAL, never counted as thematic membership).
canonical_theme_crosswalk_method_note: canonical_theme_crosswalk coverage uses ONLY the reverse-safe primary_basket_id path (company -> the ONE basket that IS a theme -> theme), per config/theme_crosswalk.yml's own documented rule that primary_basket_id is 'the only mapping that is sound in the REVERSE direction'. 13/18 canonical themes have a primary_basket_id set (5 honest nulls). A broader PROXY count exists (company -> ANY of a theme's basket_ids, including supply-chain/proxy baskets) but is NOT used for coverage math because reading it backwards would misattribute economic exposure (crosswalk's own documented caveat, e.g. a managed_care holder is not a medical-devices theme holder).

cohort_C6.definition: all C0/C1 names with NO valid thematic membership beyond structural sector/industry
cohort_C6.note: no liquidity/rank ordering used (would flirt with outcome-conditioning); top-100 taken by ascending ticker per spec. Full 2368-ticker list withheld from the committed artifact per the >=2000-row aggregate rule (no large per-row frames in git); reproducible from data/us_prophet_rank/candidates via the pinned reproduce commands.

rights_usable_split_note: Rights-usable split (internal_usable / public_display_usable / rights_blocked) is reported per source in source_family_matrix.json (this pin's D1 rows) rather than duplicated per cohort here -- rights are a property of the SOURCE, not the cohort. See config/theme_sources.yml-derived rows: mastermind_curated=direct_display_ok (100% public_display_usable); finviz_themes=unresolved (internal_usable only for new emissions, two grandfathered public paths exempted BY PATH); ths_concepts=unresolved/receipted_scrape (internal_usable only, CN-scoped, 0% relevant to US cohorts anyway); structural_sector_industry=house-derived, no restriction found.

rights_usable_split_numeric.method: rights_class is a per-SOURCE property (config/theme_sources.yml), not per-name in this repo; each source's raw_coverage count for a cohort is therefore bucketed wholesale into exactly one of {internal_usable, public_display_usable, rights_blocked} per its registry posture. Verified: internal_usable + public_display_usable + rights_blocked == raw_coverage for every source x cohort cell (assertion passed at build time).
rights_usable_split_numeric.grandfathering_note: The two finviz grandfathered surfaces (themes_heatmap.json, subsector_rotation.json) are PATH-scoped presentation exemptions on PRE-EXISTING owner surfaces -- they do not convert finviz_ltheme's underlying company-membership data to public_display_usable for a NEW emission (per config/theme_sources.yml's own scoping note: 'a surface is exempt iff its path is here with a review row... GMI emitters never cite this list').

canonical_theme_crosswalk.posture_basis: mastermind_curated row (direct_display_ok) -- the crosswalk's reverse-safe path resolves through a curated basket, which carries direct_display_ok.

finviz_ltheme.posture_basis: config/theme_sources.yml families.finviz_themes.rights_class = unresolved; review outcome states 'treat as internal_only until the operator resolves the derived-display question' -- bucketed internal_usable for a NEW emission. The two grandfathered surfaces (site/marketdata/themes_heatmap.json, subsector_rotation.json) are PATH-scoped and do not apply to a new company-membership projection.
